physics.scope: Within each native GIZMO variant, actual historical tanh versus sharp velocity. Regular equal-volume initial lattice, variable masses, original float32 IC/output precision and fully periodic native boundary recipe. Native kernel-derived density/pressure must be checked separately. No passive material tracer is assumed; particle-ID mass in MFV is not a material-retention diagnostic.

storage.policy: Conservative growth budget; allocated but reusable VHDX blocks are not credited.

mfm.method: 104 native snapshots + two restart sets with 50% margin + IC + 256MiB logs; 15% overall margin. Separate 10GiB free-space reserve.

mfv.method: 104 native snapshots + two restart sets with 50% margin + IC + 256MiB logs; 15% overall margin. Separate 10GiB free-space reserve.

plan.scope: Native MFM/MFV L3 historical/sharp only; L4/L5 are not enabled.
